text.p: Diametrics Medical Inc said Monday it has called the warrants issued in conjunction with a private equity placement in January of this year.

Effective July 31, 1997, warrants for 750,000 shares of common stock at $5.0625 per share were called, providing additional funding of $3.8 million for the company if all warrants are exercised. Warrant holders have until August 29, 1997 to exercise, the company said.

"The two private equity offerings we completed this year, supplemented by additional funding potential from attached warrants, provide most of the financing needed for implementation of our global growth strategy, based on an expanded product line of blood and tissue analysis systems," chief financial officer Larry Betterley said.
Diametrics shares were down 1/8 at 7-7/8 Monday.
